_about: OSD/OS Setup's settings beside what scripts/build-site.py reads from the app itself (the modules' manifest.json, the display presets, the themes and skins): Settings' own rows (views/Settings.qml), the choices the modules make up as they run (their backends' get_*_options), keys a module keeps without a row, and the system's lists. tests/site/schema.test.mjs checks the rows against Settings.qml and Main.qml. An option is [label, value], or a string that is both. A row's theme_part is one of the theme's parts (Settings' themeParts), legacy the numbers old words stand for, max_length and trim as the app keeps the value. The keyboards are those with Latin letters, in which a user's name and password can be typed at Exit to Terminal.

settings.label: Theme
settings.help: The whole look in one: the color scheme, the skin, the effects and the menu music. [NONE] OSD/OS's own. The rows below left at THEME follow it.

settings.label: Color Scheme
settings.help: The two colors everything is drawn in. [THEME] The theme's, else Video 1.

settings.label: Skin
settings.help: How the window is dressed: its frame, the title and hint bars, the selected line and the icons. [THEME] The theme's, else OSD/OS's own.

settings.label: Text Effect
settings.help: What the text, the lines and the bars do, on the GPU. [THEME] The theme's, else off.

settings.label: Background Effect
settings.help: What goes on behind the menus, in the window, on the GPU. [THEME] The theme's, else off.

settings.label: Selector Effect
settings.help: What goes on round the selected line. [THEME] The theme's, else off.

settings.label: Screen Effect
settings.help: A picture tube's or a tape's look over the menus, on the GPU. [THEME] The theme's, else off.

settings.label: Transition
settings.help: How one window gives way to the next. [THEME] The theme's, else off.

settings.label: Menu Music
settings.help: A tune under the menus, never while a video plays. [THEME] The theme's, if it has one. [FILE] A file of your own, below.

settings.label: Music File
settings.help: The menu music's file on the device, played over and over: MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, Opus, M4A, MIDI, XM, MOD, S3M or IT.

settings.label: Music Volume
settings.help: How loud the menu music is.

settings.label: OSD Background
settings.help: What the menus are drawn on. [FULL] The color scheme's background, all over. [OFF] None, the menus on black like a deck's on-screen display. [WINDOW] A framed window of it behind the menus, black around it.

settings.label: Window Frame
settings.help: The frame of the OSD Background's window. [SHADOW] The line and a shadow below and to the right, like a DOS window's.

settings.label: Start on Module
settings.help: Open straight into a module as OSD/OS starts. The module is turned on with it.

settings.label: Boot Screen Colors
settings.help: The colours of the boot screen, with its cassette. [THEME] The theme's or color scheme's. [DEFAULT] White on blue.

settings.label: Hint Bar
settings.help: The key hints on the bar at the foot of every screen.

settings.label: Help Line
settings.help: The box under a menu with a line about the selected row.

settings.label: Status Icons
settings.help: What is on, at the top right of the title bar: Wi-Fi's signal, Bluetooth, and the Arcade's high scores, trophy, globe and network.

settings.label: Screen Saver
settings.help: Prevent CRT burn-in after seconds of inactivity or pause.

settings.label: Mouse Pointer
settings.help: A mouse's pointer shows as it moves, and goes again after these seconds without moving.

settings.label: Scaling
settings.help: How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen, in every module that doesn't set its own. [LETTERBOX] All of it, bars above and below. [14:9] A little of the sides cut. [PAN & SCAN] Fills it, the sides cut. [ANAMORPHIC] Fills it squeezed, for a TV set to 16:9.

settings.label: Transparent Background
settings.help: How much of a video shows through the menus when back returns to them and leaves it playing behind. [SOLID] None of it, but it plays on, sound and all. Off: back stops the video, as it always has.

settings.label: Video Levels
settings.help: Match the color range your display expects. [LIMITED] If blacks crush. [FULL] If blacks look gray.

settings.label: Loading Effect
settings.help: While a video loads, a tape's noise and tracking bands roll over its counters.

settings.label: Loading Screen Colors
settings.help: The colours of the screen a video loads behind. [DEFAULT] White on blue.

settings.label: Channel Logo
settings.help: A logo in a corner of the picture while a video plays, like a channel's.

settings.label: Logo Image
settings.help: The channel logo's picture on the device, a PNG with a clear background best. Empty: OSD/OS's.

settings.label: Info Screen
settings.help: A film's details in Netflix, Prime Video and YouTube. [KEY] With right on a film. [SEC] Also on its own once the cursor rests on it.

extra.label: Server Address
extra.help: Your Jellyfin server, filled in on the sign-in screen.

extra.label: Server Address
extra.help: Your Emby server, filled in on the sign-in screen.

extra.label: Online Name
extra.placeholder: Empty: the device's name on the network
extra.help: The name the others see, online and on the network. Empty: online, the RetroAchievements account's, else OSD-OS; on the network, this device's name.
